about: Turns today's OpenStreetMap into Saigon as of late 2009. Every entry gives its reason. Zones are painted before the OSM land use (OSM water and parks still win inside them); drop_roads_inside removes OSM streets lying wholly inside the zone unless named in keep_road_names. drop_minor_streets removes the zone's named side streets (major roads stay). repaint paints the zone's class over today's land use (water stays).

drop_road_names_why.Mai Chí Thọ: the East-West avenue through Thủ Thiêm opened in 2011
drop_road_names_why.Phạm Văn Đồng: the Gò Vấp - Thủ Đức avenue opened in 2013
drop_road_names_why.Long Thành: the HCMC - Long Thành - Dầu Giây expressway opened in 2015
drop_road_names_why.Cầu Ba Son / Cầu Thủ Thiêm 2: the Ba Son bridge opened in 2022
drop_road_names_why.Vành đai 2: ring road 2 sections were built after 2010
drop_road_names_why.Võ Chí Công: the ring road 2 section through Phú Hữu opened after 2015

zones.name: Thủ Thiêm
zones.why: in 2009 the peninsula opposite District 1 was being cleared for the new town: marsh, creeks and a few old lanes; the grid streets came after 2010

zones.name: Quận 2 east and Quận 9 south
zones.why: in 2009 Bình Trưng, Thạnh Mỹ Lợi, Cát Lái and Phú Hữu were rice fields, shrimp ponds and canal villages along a few roads; the side-street grids are 2010s subdivisions

zones.name: Quận 9 around Suối Tiên
zones.why: east of Xa lộ Hà Nội the High-Tech Park was mostly empty lots in 2009 and the rest fields and villages

zones.name: Tân Cảng (now Vinhomes Central Park)
zones.why: until 2007 the Tân Cảng container port and navy land; in 2009 an emptied port yard. Vinhomes Central Park and Landmark 81 were built 2015-2018

zones.name: Ba Son shipyard (now Vinhomes Golden River)
zones.why: the Ba Son naval shipyard worked here until 2015; the towers came after

zones.name: Đảo Kim Cương
zones.why: the Diamond Island towers on the Quận 2 riverbank were built 2011-2018; in 2009 the spit was marsh

zones.name: Khu Công nghệ cao (Saigon Hi-Tech Park)
zones.why: set up in 2002, but in 2009 mostly cleared lots with a few plants (Nidec, Jabil; Intel's opened in 2010, Samsung's complex in 2016); the factory blocks and their side streets are later
